author: Brad LaPlante
title: Michigan State's Augustine, Stramel among 10 candidates to win Hobey Baker Award - NewsBreak
text:
By Brad LaPlante ,
7 hours ago
LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) — Two Michigan State men’s hockey players are finalists for the 2026 Hobey Baker Award, given to the season’s top player. Edmonton Oilers prospect Isaac Howard, who is currently playing for the Oilers AHL affiliate, Bakersfield, won the award in 2025.
Michigan State goaltender Trey Augustine and center Charlie Stramel were top-10 candidates to win the trophy. Of the final 10, three finalists will be revealed on April 3, and the winner will be announced on April 10, during the Frozen Four, before the national championship game at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.
If Augustine were to win the award, he would be the second goalie to win in the past 25 years, and the first MSU goalie since Ryan Miller in 2001. He was selected in the second round (No. 41) of the 2023 NHL Draft.
Augustine, a native of South Lyon, Michigan, has three shutouts on the season and ranks tied for fourth in save percentage (.929).
Stramel, meanwhile, is tied for 12th in points with 44 (19 goals, 25 assists) in 35 games. He is 11th in points-per-game with 1.26. Stramel, who spent his first two seasons at Wisconsin, is tied for first in the NCAA in game-winning goals (7). Michigan’s Will Horcoff has the same amount in 36 games.
Michigan forward TJ Hughes also made the list. He has 50 points (19 goals, 31 assists) on the season, which is tied for third in the NCAA. Hughes had 16 multipoint games and was named Big Ten Player of the Year. It is the second consecutive year that Hughes led Michigan in scoring.
Another notable player among the 10 finalists is center Max Plante, who plays for the University of Minnesota-Duluth. Plante was selected by the Red Wings in the second round (No. 47) of the 2024 NHL Draft.
Michigan will face Ohio State on Saturday, March 21, at 8 p.m. ET. It is the first time that Yost Ice Arena will host a Big Ten final since the hockey conference was established in 2013. Michigan is locked into the NCAA men’s hockey tournament with a No. 1-overall seed, but Ohio State’s only chance to get in would be a win against Michigan.
MSU is slated to be a No. 1 seed, as the team is ranked in the top-4 in the NPI and is unlikely to drop.
The 2026 men’s hockey tournament selection show is Sunday, March 22, at 3 p.m. ET and will air on ESPNU.
